Marketing

We use third party cookies on our site to serve you with advertisements that we believe are relevant to you and your interests. You may see these advertisements on our site and on other sites that you visit. Please note that if you disable these, you will still see adverts they just won't be tailored to your interests.

We use cookies to understand how you engage with our website across all your devices, this includes recording your browsing habits and activity. ## **Frequently asked questions**

- ### **How much is the ID.4 in the UK?**


















This depends on the trim level and configuration you choose, to get a price fo the trim and specs of your choice, visit the ID.4configurator.

- ### **What is the difference between ID.4 and ID.5?**


















The ID.4 and ID.5 are both built on the same platform, so they’re similar in size and share many features. The main difference is design: the ID.4 has a classic SUV shape, while the ID.5 is a coupé with a sportier, sloping roofline.

- ### **Is the ID.4bigger than a Tiguan?**


















The ID.4 isn’t bigger than the Tiguan. In fact, the Tiguan is slightly longer and wider. However, the ID.4 feels more spacious inside thanks to its electric platform. Because it has no transmission tunnel (the raised floor section that runs through the middle of the cabin) it offers a flat floor which means more passenger legroom. You can find out more about the Tiguan[here](https://www.volkswagen.co.uk/en/new/tiguan.html).

- ### **Does the ID.4 have good boot space?**


















ID.4 boot space is good, offering 543 litres with the rear seats up, and a roomy 1,575 litres when they’re folded down. It’s practical for families, easily fitting shopping, a pushchair, or golf clubs, and there’s a handy false floor to store charging cables neatly.

- ### **Does the ID.4 have self-driving?**


















The ID.4 doesn’t offer full self-driving, but it does come with a range of driver assist features to make driving easier and safer. Depending on the model and trim level, you’ll find systems like Adaptive Cruise Control, Lane Assist, Front Assist, and optional extras like Travel Assist and Park Assist Plus.

- ### **What is the ID.4’s towing capacity?**


















The VolkswagenID.4 can tow up to 750 kg with an unbraked trailer and up to 1,200 kg with a braked trailer. All-wheel-drive models like the ID.4 Pro 4MOTION can tow up to 1,400 kg (braked). Always check your vehicle’s manual for the exact towing limit.
